title: Open source AI is booming. Hugging Face explains who profits.
slides: Hugging Face hosts 1M+ models — but who actually profits?
Open source AI adoption is doubling every year
Most value flows to a few infrastructure players, not builders
Your next model choice may lock you into a vendor stack
Check your dependencies before committing to a stack
thread_text:
1. The AI Profit Illusion

Hugging Face now hosts over 1 million models. But the real money isn't made by those who build them—it's made by those who control the infrastructure.

2. Adoption Is Doubling

Open source AI adoption is doubling every year. More teams are choosing open models over proprietary APIs, shifting the balance of power.

3. Follow the Money

Most value flows to a few infrastructure players, not the builders. Compute, hosting, and tooling capture the profits while model creators often see little.

4. The Lock-In Trap

Your next model choice may lock you into a vendor stack. Dependencies on proprietary tools can limit your flexibility and increase long-term costs.

5. Check Your Dependencies

Before committing to a stack, audit your dependencies. Ask: can I switch models without rewriting my entire pipeline? If not, you're already locked in.
